name: @fhevm/sdk-vendored-dev
//: - Holds reference code meant to be COPIED, not just imported: each file is stored byte-identical to
what a consumer would paste into their project. sdk/scripts/sync-vendored-ts.ts copies the ones a
- src/ethereumLibTypes.ts declares the adapter interfaces locally so an adapter is self-contained.
It is a COPY of each generation pkg/ts/types/public.ts, and scripts/check-vendored-types.sh is what
proves it still matches. That check is a SCRIPT, not a type import, on purpose: importing the
generations here would make vendored depend on packages that already depend on vendored.
- Separate from common/ because these files import common. Keeping them inside it made a package
import itself by name, which node allows via self-reference but which inverts the layering.
- Depends on @fhevm/sdk-common-dev and NOTHING else in the workspace. Nothing may be added here that
any member depends on, or the graph gains a cycle.
- ethers/viem are NOT declared: the root pins them and hoists one copy (scripts/check-dep-versions.ts).
- `lint` runs tsc ONLY. eslint must never touch src/: an autofix would silently diverge a copy.
